directional_result.promising_direction: shoju-068 host <- E=もひも from five-elements

directional_result.lesson: Same scene and same D seam are insufficient. The imported E must preserve the semantic role that the host central phrase performs.

proposed_rule.name: factor-semantic-role-compatibility
proposed_rule.requirement: For E-only swaps, compare not only scene tags but the host central phrase's discourse/semantic role such as enumeration, action, description, evaluation, or pivot.

next_step: Add semantic-role compatibility to the central-pivot exchange model, then retest the はに and みつ cases without converting the rule into a numeric naturalness score.
